name: Sacramental Brew
body:
You can give your potions a holy zing.

Prerequisite(s): Brew Potion, able to cast bless water and enhance water.

Benefit: You can imbue a potion with positive energy as if it were water, creating it as both holy water and the potion it was made from. The cost of creating a sacramental brew is equal to 25 gp + the cost of the potion.
